Tooltip_NE_AntiMutantDrug: A powerful drug that reduces internal mutation by 40-60%. Causes severe damage and dizziness upon consumption.
Tooltip_NE_Retardant: Completely stops mutation accumulation from environmental contamination for a set period.
Tooltip_NE_DeconSpray: Sprays bleach in a cone to purify floors and clothing. Essential for base maintenance.
Tooltip_NE_DeconGrenade: Instantly neutralizes wide-area contamination upon explosion. For emergency escape.
Tooltip_NE_HomemadeSanitizer: A sanitizer refined from agricultural alcohol. Lower duration and purification capacity compared to bleach.
Tooltip_NE_GasMask: A protective mask with a specialized filter. Protects the lungs from the contaminated atmosphere.
Tooltip_NE_HazmatSuit: A full protective suit adjusted for test subjects. Protects the whole body from the virus.
Tooltip_NE_FilterReload: Restores gas mask filter life to 100% (Reload).
Tooltip_NE_Nucleus: A core of mutation that emits intense viral contamination. It acts as an epicenter itself. Recovered from the lab by Dr. Hiro and sealed in a containment vial.
